candidates.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
candidates.summary: Learn how to build a serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate that gives AI agents secure, metadata-driven access to an enterprise data lake. Exposing a new dataset requires only a JSON file, with no per-dataset integration code.

candidates.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
candidates.summary: In Part 1 you built one governed agent. Part 2 scales the pattern to an enterprise: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway becomes the single front door and redeems Okta's grant, Cedar policies bind each tool to the agent, a second agent runs on Amazon EKS, and AgentCore Observability traces every allow and deny beside Okta's log in Amazon CloudWatch.

candidates.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
candidates.summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
